newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices ease in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices ease in slow trade.

text.p: Gold prices and turnover fell on the Istanbul Gold Exchange in line with the trend on international markets, dealers said.
Gold closed $1.10 lower on Tuesday at $378.50 an ounce while it tumbled to an 18-month low fix of $377.05 in London. It later firmed to $378.60 an ounce after the New York opening.
The market also fell in lira terms to 1,119,000 lira from Monday's 1,120,700 close. The lira closed at 91,850 to the dollar, down from a 91,720 Monday close.
Total volume slid to 657 kilos from Monday's 1,108.

"Quiet trade in the currency market raised gold demand in the first session but the gold demand stopped in the afternoon due to uncertainty in the international gold market," said Yusuf Kiremitci from Sembol Doviz.
